programmes.name_local: Enova stotte til ny energi- og klimateknologi i industrien
programmes.name_en: Enova support for new energy and climate technology in industry
programmes.amount_note: Maximum support under the programme is EUR 25 million; up to 50% of total costs (depends on project activity and company size).
programmes.deadline_note: Programme is always open with no fixed application deadlines.

eligibility.other_note: Applicant must be registered in the Norwegian business register (Brønnøysundregistrene) and the project must be delivered in Norway.

programmes.source_snippet: Maksimal støtte på programmet er 25 millioner euro. Inntil 50 % av de totale kostnadene ... Dette programmet er alltid åpent og har ikke faste søknadsfrister

programmes.name_local: Enova – støtte til innovativ energi- og klimateknologi
programmes.name_en: Enova support for innovative energy and climate technology
programmes.amount_note: Grant for pilot and demonstration of new energy and climate technology; grant share depends on the programme and project maturity.
programmes.deadline_note: Several Enova programmes use periodic application cut-offs during the year.

programmes.funder: European Space Agency (ESA) with the national space agency or regional co-funder
programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: ESA BIC Norway deadlines: 1 October 2026 (passed) and 1 March 2027.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local ESA BIC to discuss suitability
Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Norway before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Product or service with a clear space connection; registered Norwegian company under 5 years old; legal work permit in Norway; entrepreneurs own more than 50% of the company. Incubation lasts 12-24 months.

programmes.source_snippet: Next deadline: March 1st, 2027 ... A registrered NO company under 5 years of age ... The incubation lasts minimum 12 months and maximum 24 months.

programmes.name_en: Innovation Project in the Industrial Sector
programmes.amount_note: R&D project grant led by a company; grant share typically up to 45-50% of project costs for SMEs, with the company covering the rest.
programmes.deadline_note: 2026 IPN calls (Industri og tjenestenæringer, Sjømat, Landbasert bioøkonomi, Energi og transport) list a continuous (Løpende) application deadline.
programmes.source_snippet: Innovasjonsprosjekt i næringslivet: Industri og tjenestenæringer 2026 - Løpende

programmes.amount_note: Grant to supplier companies developing new products with a committed pilot customer. Page lists 'Minimum 1 million kroner'; small companies can have up to 45% of project costs covered. Pilot customer must contribute at least 20% of total project costs.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende (continuous).

eligibility.other_note: Requires a binding collaboration with a pilot customer (public or private, normally no ownership link) who contributes at least 20% of project costs; project must have commercial potential beyond the pilot customer; must comply with state-aid rules.

programmes.source_snippet: Små bedrifter kan få dekket inntil 45 prosent av kostnadene i prosjektet. ... Løpende ... Minimum 1 million kroner

programmes.amount_note: Historic scheme for commercialisation of validated ideas. Discontinued.
programmes.deadline_note: Discontinued. Replaced by Oppstartstilskudd 2 and 3.
programmes.reopen_note: Permanently replaced by Oppstartstilskudd 2 (up to NOK 1m) and Oppstartstilskudd 3. Apply to those instead.

programmes.amount_note: Historic scheme: up to NOK 100,000 to clarify market potential. Discontinued.
programmes.deadline_note: Discontinued. Replaced by Oppstartstilskudd 1.
programmes.reopen_note: Permanently replaced by Oppstartstilskudd 1 (max NOK 150,000), which serves the same market-validation purpose. Apply to Oppstartstilskudd 1 instead.

programmes.name_en: Start-up Grant 1 – Test the business idea in the market
programmes.amount_note: Maximum NOK 150,000. Used to establish whether there is a paying market for the business idea.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende (continuous). Processing time stated as 3–4 weeks.

procedure_steps.detail: Register in Innovasjon Norge's application portal with the company's org.nr
Describe the business idea, market hypothesis and planned market-testing activities
Submit; case handling takes approximately 3-4 weeks

eligibility.other_note: Innovative startups younger than five years, established as aksjeselskap (AS), with growth ambitions. Grant covers up to 100% of invoiced external costs, but applicant must advance at least 50% of project costs before reimbursement.

programmes.source_snippet: Tilskuddet retter seg mot innovative oppstartsbedrifter som har et krevende teknologiutviklingsløp foran seg. Maks 150 000 kroner.

programmes.amount_note: Up to NOK 1 million for technical and commercial validation. The grant is set assuming no other public support (including SkatteFUNN) is received for the same costs.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende (continuous). 2026 budget reduced by 60%, resulting in stricter prioritisation and more rejections.

eligibility.other_note: AS registered less than five years ago, genuine new venture with growth potential. Grant covers up to 50% of eligible costs; own financing must equal the grant and be available before first disbursement. In 2026 the budget for Oppstartstilskudd 2 was reduced by 60%, so prioritisation is stricter.

programmes.source_snippet: Målet med denne fasen er å gjøre tekniske og forretningsmessige avklaringer for å se om bedriftens forslag til løsning kan danne grunnlag for en lønnsom forretningsmodell.

programmes.amount_note: Financing to prepare the company for commercial operations. Private investors must commit at least 2/3 of the phase financing. Innovasjon Norge does not publish a fixed ceiling on the service page.

eligibility.other_note: Company younger than five years; team of at least two FTEs; board with at least two external members; private investors committed to at least 2/3 of the phase; sustainability aligned with the EU taxonomy or addressing societal challenges.

programmes.source_snippet: Finansiering til denne fasen skal benyttes til å forberede bedriften på kommersiell drift.

programmes.amount_note: Tax deduction of 19% of approved R&D costs, with an annual cap on eligible costs per company set in the national budget.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications accepted year-round. Submit by 1 May for an answer before summer holidays; submit by 1 September to be guaranteed processing within the current year.

programmes.amount_note: Loan of up to NOK 25 million for profitable development and investment projects; normally up to 50% of the company's capital need. With EIF guarantee, up to EUR 2 million per loan transaction (max exposure EUR 7.5 million). Nominal interest 8.20% (7.86% max with EIF guarantee) for new loans from 29 Sept 2026; 0.5% establishment fee; term normally up to 15 years.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling). Projects started before a written application is received cannot be financed.

eligibility.other_note: Companies in all industries across Norway with innovation, growth and internationalisation; EIF-guaranteed loans only for SMEs and small mid-caps (<500 FTE). Traditional retail, personal services, rentals, crafts and mainly local/regional businesses are not prioritised.

programmes.source_snippet: Innovasjonslån er en gunstig toppfinansiering av lønnsomme utviklings- og investeringsprosjekter, der bedriften ikke får ordinær bankfinansiering fordi den ikke kan stille sikkerhet for hele lånet.

programmes.amount_note: Loan of up to NOK 35 million, financing up to 75% of an investment; interest 7.90% (max 7.65% with EIF guarantee) for new loans from 29 Sept 2026; no establishment fee; up to two interest-free years and three years of amortisation holiday; collateral required.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling).

eligibility.other_note: Norwegian companies, preferably SMEs; project must have quantified environmental effects and qualify under the EU taxonomy; core technology must be tested and ready for industrialisation; needs one or more long-term owners with solid financial capacity.

programmes.source_snippet: Grønt risikolån retter seg mot klima- og miljøvennlige investeringer i norske bedrifter.

programmes.amount_note: Long-term loan covering up to 50% of the capital need, with nominal interest from 6.15% for new loans from 29 Sept 2026; fixed or floating rate and tenor adapted to the company; secured mainly by pledges, guarantees and sureties.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling).

eligibility.other_note: Primarily for SMEs in all industries across Norway, but also large companies; requires satisfactory finances and adequate security.

programmes.source_snippet: Lavrisikolån er et tilbud til bedrifter med behov for finansiering av et langsiktig kapitalbehov.

programmes.amount_note: Loan of NOK 1-2 million per company (max NOK 2 million, may be granted twice at NOK 1 million each), up to 50% of approved project costs; interest-free for two years, then 8.20%; six-year term with first three years amortisation-free; secured by pledge over company assets.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling).

eligibility.other_note: Must be an AS or Norwegian-registered foreign enterprise (NUF) established less than five years ago (sole proprietorships, ANS, DA not accepted); genuine new establishment; own financing at least equal to the loan; board with at least one external member; no ongoing payment remarks.

programmes.source_snippet: Lånet retter seg mot oppstartsbedrifter med vekstpotensial, og kan finansiere organisasjonsutvikling og markedsarbeid. Lånet kan innvilges to ganger, til sammen maksimalt 2 millioner kroner.

programmes.amount_note: Grant of at least NOK 1 million covering a share of approved project costs (incl. personnel) for development, piloting and demonstration of new environmental technology; granted under GBER; can be combined with SkatteFUNN or IN loans within state-aid limits.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling). Pre-studies and pre-projects are not covered in 2026.

eligibility.other_note: Norwegian companies in all industries; aimed especially at supplier companies developing environmental technology for sale. Impact must be quantified vs best available technology and compatible with the EU taxonomy.

programmes.source_snippet: Miljøteknologiordningen gir tilskudd til utvikling, pilotering og demonstrasjon av ny miljøteknologi.

programmes.name_local: IP-tilskudd til avklaring av immaterielle verdier
programmes.amount_note: Grant of NOK 15,000-50,000 to buy external IP specialist advice (patentability checks, freedom-to-operate, IP strategy, legal help on ownership and licensing); does not cover filing or maintenance fees.
programmes.deadline_note: No fixed deadline; company must be in active advisory dialogue with Innovasjon Norge IPR advisers.

eligibility.other_note: Norwegian founder or small company with international growth ambitions; must be able to receive de minimis state aid.

programmes.source_snippet: IP-avklaringstilskudd er for gründere og bedrifter med nyskapende løsninger og internasjonale ambisjoner, der immaterielle verdier (IP) og rettigheter (IPR) er avgjørende for videre utvikling, finansiering og vekst.

programmes.name_en: Growth Loan for Internationalisation and Export
programmes.amount_note: Loan of NOK 10-25 million (up to 50% of the capital need, no bank co-financing required); with EIF guarantee up to EUR 2 million per transaction. Nominal interest 11.55% (max 10.21% with EIF guarantee) for new loans from 29 Sept 2026; term 3-5 years; deferred establishment fee plus risk premium totalling 5% of the loan.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling).

eligibility.other_note: Export companies with some revenue outside Norway, combined revenue above NOK 40 million over the last three years with average annual growth of at least 20%, a capital need of at least NOK 20 million, and new cash equity of at least NOK 20 million raised or to be raised; limited pledgeable assets.

programmes.source_snippet: Vekstlån gir bedrifter økt arbeidskapital for å akselerere veksten på internasjonale markeder.

programmes.amount_note: Grant of at least NOK 1 million covering a share of approved project costs (including personnel costs) for development and testing of new bio-resource-based products and solutions, including pilot and demonstration plants in Norway; granted under GBER.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling). Pre-studies and pre-projects are not covered in 2026.

eligibility.other_note: Companies of all sizes across Norway in production, processing and distribution of bio-resources from land, forest and sea; environmental effect must be quantified against best available technology.

programmes.source_snippet: Bioøkonomiordningen gir tilskudd til utvikling og testing av nye produkter og løsninger basert på bioressurser.

programmes.amount_note: Grant of up to NOK 1 million per company, covering up to 100% of approved costs (no own-funding requirement); paid 50% upfront, 30% after mid-term report, 20% after final report.
programmes.deadline_note: Søknadsfrist: Utløpt (call expired as shown on page); check page for the next call.

eligibility.other_note: Recent graduates/students at Norwegian universities or colleges (master, six-year professional or PhD level; project lead enrolled or graduated within the last 12 months); students must own at least 80% of the company; needs agreements with the institution and a commercial mentor and documented market acceptance.

programmes.source_snippet: Er dere studenter ved et norsk universitet eller høyskole med en forretningside og har ambisjoner om å starte bedrift?

programmes.amount_note: Innovasjon Norge guarantees 75% of the bank's loss on bank loans of up to NOK 8 million per company (term loans up to 10 years, operating credit 1-4 years); applied for through participating banks. Establishment fee 1% of maximum guarantee in year one plus 0.75% annual guarantee commission.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende; the application goes through a participating bank (Danske Bank, DNB, Nordea and several savings banks).

eligibility.other_note: Innovative and/or fast-growing businesses with up to 250 employees (including group), registered and located in Norway, assessed by their bank as able to service debt but lacking sufficient collateral.

programmes.source_snippet: Vekstgaranti skal styrke tilgangen til bankfinansiering for innovative og/eller raskt voksende små og mellomstore bedrifter.

programmes.funder: Innovasjon Norge (on behalf of Troms fylkeskommune)
programmes.amount_note: Grant for pre-studies, pre-projects, main projects, investments, business networks and collaboration projects that create value in Northern Norway (Nordland, Troms, Finnmark); amount depends on the project.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling).

eligibility.other_note: Primarily SMEs; applicant need not be located in Northern Norway but must show the results benefit the northern regions. Agriculture, fishing fleet, tourism and creative industries are excluded (separate IN products). Focus: technology for Arctic conditions and innovative ecosystems.

programmes.source_snippet: Ordningen gjelder primært SMB. Aktører, som for eksempel næringshager, klynger, inkubatorer, kan også motta støtte.

programmes.admin_area: Districts within the Norwegian district-policy area
programmes.funder: Innovasjon Norge (on behalf of county authorities)
programmes.amount_note: Start-up grants, business development grants, investment grants and risk loans (same terms as the innovation loan but weighting regional benefit) for companies inside the district-policy area; amounts vary by county.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling). Projects started before the application cannot be supported.

eligibility.other_note: Mainly SMEs and entrepreneurs located in municipalities inside the district-policy area; priorities set by each county's assignment letter (value creation, employment, innovation, restructuring).

programmes.source_snippet: Vi har et mål om at verdier skapes over hele landet. Vi har derfor egne ordninger for selskaper i distriktene, og andre krav til selskapene som kan kvalifisere seg.

programmes.amount_note: Grant of up to NOK 1,000,000 per year for up to three years covering network administration and project management; funding share up to 100% of approved support base as de minimis aid, with cash contributions from participants.
programmes.deadline_note: Løpende søknadsfrist (rolling).

eligibility.other_note: Network of at least three SMEs established in Norway with sound finances and no normal ownership links; Norwegian SMEs must be at least 50% of participants; one member acts as applicant/administrator.

programmes.source_snippet: Vi kan tilby faglig veiledning, og finansiering til etablering og utvikling av bedriftsnettverk-prosjekter.

programmes.funder: Norges forskningsråd, Innovasjon Norge and Siva
programmes.amount_note: Total call of up to NOK 644.5 million for new three-year Green Platform projects starting early 2027; project size NOK 30-80 million.
programmes.deadline_note: 2026 outline (skisse) deadline was 4 June; a mandatory outline is required before the main application; main-application deadline not shown on the page at verification.

eligibility.other_note: Primarily Norwegian companies and research institutes (Norwegian organisation number required); only Norwegian companies or research institutes may submit the main application; open to all technology areas and sectors.

programmes.source_snippet: Forskningsrådet, Innovasjon Norge og Siva lyser ut inntil 644,5 millioner kroner til nye treårige Grønn plattform-prosjekter med oppstart tidlig 2027.
